coefficient_domain: Q(i), represented by signed integer numerators and nonzero positive denominators
wavevectors: k,l in Z^3, k cross l nonzero
amplitudes: A,B in Q(i)^3; k dot A=l dot B=0; conjugate partners at negative modes
carrier_contract: No alias. All original modes and both signed cross-frequency pairs are retained. Zero and self outputs are handled explicitly.
raw_ordered_pair_rule: i*[q*(u_p dot u_q)-(q dot u_p)*u_q], p+q=m, complex bilinear dot, every ordered pair retained
outputs: raw R_m; for nonzero m, sigma_m=(m dot R_m)/|m|^2 and P_m R_m=R_m-m*sigma_m; zero raw is directly checked

complete_classification.single_mode: A=0 or B=0: zero projected quadratic output
complete_classification.normal: Both amplitudes parallel over C to n=k cross l: zero projected quadratic output
complete_classification.remaining_family: Only if U=|k|^2=|l|^2: A=alpha*(U*l-s*k+i*tau*n)/Delta, B=beta*(U*k-s*l-i*tau*n)/Delta, alpha,beta nonzero complex, tau real, s=k dot l, Delta=U^2-s^2

first_cases.expected: projected zero, nonzero raw and sigma
nonzero projected output at four cross modes

arithmetic_boundary: Native quotients and residues use existing BRC facade with traces; integer cross multiplication or explicit unevaluated quotients are permitted. Do not replace complex bilinear coefficients with positive mass.
hard_target: Inclusion-minimal sufficient subsets in this fixed menu: factorization for raw R/sigma/projection and exact same-observer/different-output fibers for essential fields. A portable consumer carries the claim; full-menu sufficiency is supplied.
base_observer: k,l and modal energies A dot conj(A), B dot conj(B)
full_menu_reconstruction: R_2k=i*k*Jk; R_2l=i*l*Jl; R_(k+l)=i*((k+l)*S-X-Y); R_(k-l)=i*((k-l)*T+Z-W); negative modes by conjugacy; R_0=0
